Class TotpChainCustomizer.SessionStrategyConfigurer

All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.config.annotation.SecurityConfigurer<org.springframework.security.web.DefaultSecurityFilterChain,org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity>
Enclosing class:
TotpChainCustomizer
static final class TotpChainCustomizer.SessionStrategyConfigurer extends org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configurers.AbstractHttpConfigurer<TotpChainCustomizer.SessionStrategyConfigurer,org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity>
Hands the session authentication strategy of the chain to the TOTP filter. The strategy is a shared object of the chain that only exists once every configurer has been initialised (the CSRF configurer adds its CsrfAuthenticationStrategy to the session management one), so it is read in configure(org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity), as the form login does for its own filter. Package-private so its test can drive it.
